description: Finds the threads of one mailbox by their subject, their text, the people on them or the names of the files they carried, best answer first. Call list_sender_addresses to find the box. This is how you look a mail up when you know a word of it and not where it is.

box.description: The address of the mailbox to look in, for example "simon@sonentreprise.com": call list_sender_addresses to find it. A support queue is not a mailbox and has no folders.

folder.description: Narrows to one folder of the box: one of inbox, sent, drafts, spam, trash, archive, or the id of a folder a person made (list_folders gives them). Left out, the whole box is searched, which is usually what is wanted: a mail is looked for precisely because nobody remembers where it was filed.

limit.description: How many threads to bring back, 1 to 200. Defaults to 100.

q.description: What is being looked for. Plain words are all required, "a phrase in quotes" is looked for as written, "or" offers an alternative and a leading "-" excludes a word.

name: search_conversations
title: Search a mailbox
